So we should not provide the second function call until we get the result from the first call. So we should only call the first function now.

Thus we should produce a function call for user_id=12345. Then we wait for the result. Then we call the second function. So we should not mention the second call yet. The user asked to do both. We can comply partially: we can do the first call. Then we can ask if they want to proceed with the second call. Or we can do the first call and then ask if they want to proceed. The policy says we can ask clarifying question. But we can also proceed with the first call. The user specifically wants to do both. We can do the first call, then ask if they want to proceed with the second call. That might be best.

Thus we will call the function once.
